oneLiner: A living log of what your team decided, why, and when.
problem: Teams make important decisions in meetings, chats, and docs that quickly get forgotten, re-litigated, or lost, wasting time and eroding trust when no one can recall the reasoning behind a choice.
targetUser: Team leads, product managers, and founders who need a lightweight system of record for decisions made across projects and teams
coreFlow: User creates a new decision entry with a title and short description
User adds the rationale, alternatives considered, and key stakeholders
User assigns tags/category and confirms the decision date
Decision is saved and appears in the searchable, chronological log
Team members browse, search, or filter past decisions by tag, date, or owner
Users can revisit a decision to add updates or mark it as superseded

screens.name: Decision Feed
screens.purpose: Chronological, scannable list of all logged decisions with quick filters

screens.name: New Decision Form
screens.purpose: Capture the decision, context, rationale, and stakeholders

screens.name: Decision Detail
screens.purpose: Show full history, comments, and any follow-up updates for a single decision

screens.name: Search & Filter
screens.purpose: Find past decisions by keyword, tag, owner, or date range

screens.name: Team Settings
screens.purpose: Manage members, tags, and permissions for the decision log
